column1: # BMF letters and official form instructions. Columns, separated by tabs:
# id, kind, year, date, reference, title, source, url, download, sha256
# Write - for an empty field, except the last one. kind is letter or instructions.
# year is the tax year that the entry applies to. A letter is taken from the handbook edition of
# that year, unless a later edition says that a newer letter applies to that year.
# date and reference are the date and Geschäftszeichen of a letter, as the annex prints them,
# source is where the entry is printed: the handbook annex and the Bundessteuerblatt page of a
# letter, or the menu path of a form instruction.
# download is handbook when the text is in law/text/<handbook>-<year>.md, which
# java scripts/FetchHandbooks.java builds and law/handbooks.tsv pins. It is browser when the owner
# must download the file to law/guidance/<id>.pdf. It is gap when no official source prints
# the entry yet. Do not fill a gap from memory.
# sha256 is the hash of a browser file. scripts/guidance.sh fetch --pin fills an empty hash.
